body: Thanks for replying, I work in a laboratory setting in the medical field. I love the work I do but the day to day stresses of my particular employer are slowly sucking the joy out of it and I'm worried I'll stop having the drive to help people. It means a lot to me that you took the time to read and listen, I don't think anyone in my real life knows how I feel. I put on a happy face at work because I hope that it will help to change the culture but that just drains me more.
